content: {"reasoning":"The CO-97 denial remains appealable through peer-to-peer review, and the payer explicitly offers that option; retro authorization and information-request workflows do not apply. Although similar claims had low peer-to-peer success, resubmitting an adjudicated claim or billing the patient for a bundled provider-liability denial would violate the appropriate path, and the prior necessity appeal has already failed.","action":"request_peer_to_peer"}
